name: After § 1 – 4
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Adjustments in expenditure, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text: 1a. Disagrees with the approach taken by the Commission in Draft amending budget No 3/2026 notably that additional revenue amounting to EUR 4 765 million from definitive fines and penalty payments, together with EUR 1 100 million in traditional own resources, allows Member States’ GNI-based contributions to be reduced only by EUR 1 703 million, despite an increase of EUR 4 162,4 million in payment appropriations; considers that such exceptional revenue should primarily benefit Member States and taxpayers; calls on the Commission to strengthen budgetary discipline and give priority to the more efficient use of existing resources;
